# mgc_dbaas_clusters_snapshot (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a specific DBaaS (Database-as-a-Service) cluster snapshot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mgc_dbaas_clusters_snapshot" "example" {
  id         = "snapshot-123"
  cluster_id = "cluster-123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the DBaaS cluster the snapshot belongs to.
- `id` (String) ID of the snapshot to retrieve.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp of when the snapshot was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the snapshot.
- `name` (String) Name of the snapshot.
- `size` (Number) Size of the snapshot in GB.
- `status` (String) Current status of the snapshot ([PENDING, CREATING, AVAILABLE, RESTORING, ERROR, DELETING, DELETED]).
